Himmat swarg ki taraf le jaati hai, darr maut ki taraf.
Jo tum nahi kar sakte usse jo kar sakte ho mat rokne do.
Ek saaf aur shaant zameer insaan ko majboot banata hai.
Bravery darr ke saath move karna hai.
Khamoshi sach ke liye jagah banati.
Chup rehna sahmati dikhata hai.
Grit tab bhi rukna hai jab dard ho.
Darr rokta nahi; tumhari choice rok sakti.
Himmat mein jaadoo aur taqat hai.
Agar fast jaana hai, akelay jao. Agar door jaana hai, saath jao.
Mahaan dimaag vicharon par, aam dimaag ghatnaon par, aur chhote dimaag logon par baatchaat karte hain.
Khade raho, bahadur bano.
Jab aapne saari sambhavnaayein aazma li ho, toh yaad rakhein: abhi bhi kuch baaki hai.
Lagatar rehna hi sab kuch hai.
Chup rehna shabdon se zyada sikhata hai.
